title: HB1496 (2020 Regular Session): Modifies the offenses of unlawful transfer of weapons and unlawful possession of a firearm.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.060 (RSMo): 1. A person commits the offense of unlawful transfer of weapons if he or she: (4) Knowingly sells, leases, loans, gives away, or delivers a firearm to any person whose name appears on the Terrorist Screening Center's No Fly List; or (5) Knowingly sells, leases, loans, gives away, or delivers a firearm to any person who is a member of a group of two or more individuals, regardless if organized, that engages in or has a subgroup that engages in international or domestic terrorism.
Section 571.060 (RSMo): 2. Unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivision (1), (4), or (5) of subsection 1 of this section is a class E felony; unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivisions (2) and (3) of subsection 1 of this section is a class A misdemeanor.
Section 571.070 (RSMo): 1. A person commits the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm if such person knowingly has any firearm in his or her possession and: (3) Such person's name appears on the Terrorist Screening Center's No Fly List; or (4) Such person is a member of a group of two or more individuals, regardless if organized, that engages in or has a subgroup that engages in international or domestic terrorism.
